articles.title: CVS Health Restructuring Preserves Core PBM and Caremark Operations
articles.summary: CVS Health is undergoing a corporate breakup, but the restructuring strategically keeps its most impactful healthcare delivery and PBM divisions intact. For self-funded employers, this structural shift signals ongoing consolidation within integrated pharmacy and medical benefits giants, impacting pricing transparency and market leverage.

articles.title: CVS Health Consider Splitting Retail Pharmacy and PBM Operations
articles.summary: CVS Health is exploring a structural separation of its retail drugstore and pharmacy benefit management businesses, signaling a major shift in integrated healthcare models. This potential breakup could significantly impact market dynamics, pricing structures, and competitive strategies for self-funded employers and alternative PBMs.
articles.source_line: Source: Texarkana Gazette; Sun, 08 Nov 2026 04:00:00 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Challenges Tennessee PBM Ownership Ban in Federal Court
articles.summary: CVS Health has filed a federal lawsuit challenging a Tennessee law that bans certain pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) ownership structures. This legal battle carries significant implications for state-level PBM regulation, corporate operational models, and the broader legislative landscape affecting PBMs and self-funded employer plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Sun, 08 Nov 2026 01:16:00 GMT
